summary: Independently re-derived Phase 144D's F-1/JC-2 finding (a Publication Coordinator implementing PEC-001 cannot produce a CHGR-001 Sec.10-complete record because its sole permitted input, PublicationReadinessPackage, carries only identifier/digest references, never verbatim decision content) directly from IWC-001, PEC-001, CHGR-001, and the actual interactive_workflow/governance/publication source -- not from 144D's own framing. Root cause independently confirmed as Option A (insufficient Package content): direct reading of PublicationHandoff.build_package shows it already receives the full Session/Preview/ConfirmationRequest/ConfirmationResponse objects, with human_selection_id, human_rationale_text, human_conditions_text, owner_identity, template_ref, and subject_ref all populated, at the exact moment the package is constructed, but discards every substantive value, retaining only session_id/session_state/reference/digest fields. Option C (information outside every frozen boundary) independently rejected -- every required value already exists inside interactive_workflow's own boundary. Option B (Coordinator lacks a read path) evaluated as an alternative (Model 2) and rejected as primary -- would require relaxing PEC-REQ-018-020's AST-enforced import boundary or duplicating PublicationHandoff's existing construction responsibility, for data already reachable without any new coupling. Evaluated four resolution models (widen the Package; grant a frozen Coordinator read interface; hybrid; other) and adopted Model 1 (widen PublicationReadinessPackage) as strictly cheaper and less invasive. Revised IWC-001 v1.1->v1.2 (docs/contracts/INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md Sec.26, IWC-REQ-185 through IWC-REQ-190): the Package additively widened to carry, verbatim and immutably, Decision Subject, bound Decision Template identity+version, selected option id, rationale/conditions text where supplied, the full option set presented, decision-maker identity evidence, the exact rendered Preview content, and confirmation act evidence, all captured once at construction/generation time, never re-derived downstream. Revised PEC-001 v1.0->v1.1 (docs/contracts/PUBLICATION_EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md Sec.20, PEC-REQ-111 through PEC-REQ-117): describes how a future Coordinator implementation consumes the widened Package into CHGR-001 Sec.10's required human_governance_record/human_confirmation_evidence/governance_record_provenance fields, with PEC-REQ-113 explicitly restating that no new Coordinator dependency on interactive_workflow internals is introduced or authorized -- content arrives solely through the Package, and the existing AST-enforced forbidden-import test remains unweakened. Both revisions are additive only: no existing IWC-REQ-001 through IWC-REQ-184 or PEC-REQ-001 through PEC-REQ-110 requirement is narrowed, superseded, or reworded (independently confirmed by regression review, Sec.26.4 and Sec.20.3 of the respective contracts). CHGR-001, TAMC-001, and TAMPC-001 remain byte-identical; independently reconfirmed structurally disjoint and unaffected. No implementation performed: zero files under src/pcae/interactive_workflow/** or src/pcae/governance/publication/** appear in this phase's diff (Forbidden Files for this phase's own task contract). Runtime confirmed unchanged (Observed/observe/unavailable) via pcae runtime inspect at phase start and close. Recommended next phase: 144F - Provenance Boundary Implementation, to actually widen the dataclasses and record.py against the now-frozen contract text; not authorized by this phase. See docs/PHASE_144E_PUBLICATION_EXECUTION_CONTRACT_REVISION.md.
